name: Paul Pietsch
features: fair skin, dark hair receding to a high bald crown, dark eyes, broad open face, strong nose, stocky build, wide easy grin
bio: A Freiburg privateer who started in 1932 on a Bugatti and an Alfa, won two Swedish ice races, and got a works Auto Union seat in 1935 — third at Monza, then out, unable to make peace with the rear-engined car. His great day came in the wet at the 1939 German Grand Prix, where he led the Silver Arrows from lap two in a private Maserati 8CTF until the ignition let go. He founded 'Das Auto' after the war and built Motor Presse Stuttgart, and at 100 was the first Grand Prix driver ever to reach the mark.
